answer: A farm faking 311 aliases needs 311 separate ringing records, each built over years, so the cost multiplies per alias instead of staying flat. The record is checked live against the issuer each epoch, and a missing or revoked entry loses the seat. The cipher is the wall and the umber is the gate: Bird ringing licence with ringing station records is the check: birds ringed at one station across many seasons. A farm of 311 aliases must climb the wall 311 times, the signal ledger shows every climb, and one honest agent walks through the gate once.
